card.name: Small words in programming how-to text
card.fires_on: Small linking or verb words (to, find, achieve, effect, a) in technical programming or command-line explanations, just before the text states what a command or step does.

modes.label: Purpose phrase
modes.description: The word 'to' or a comma introducing how to accomplish something with a command.
modes.example: For instance,<< to>> view your security context: # id -

modes.label: Verb after command
modes.description: A verb right after a code function, describing what it is used to do.
modes.example: Use count(*) to<< find>> out the number of records in a table

modes.label: Assembly discussion
modes.description: Words in a forum question about assembly loops and their effect.
modes.example: what stops the<< loop>> ? djnz operates on c
